name: Tower climb
what: Checks the Tower is still moving. A site with no progress for 3 days gives way, and the guard does it itself when the scheduled run did not.
schedule: with every house lane run, about every 2 hours
last: The Tower is on nameunit and has made progress inside the 3 days it is allowed.

cost.note: No model call. Reads the Tower files already in the repo.
